-- ==================================================
-- CONFIG
-- ==================================================
Pos1 = { x = 2, y = 0, z = 0 }
Pos2 = { x = 0, y = 0, z = 0 }
Pos3 = { x = -2.0, y = 0, z = 0 }
PosDestination = { x = 0, y = 2, z = 5 }
-- ==================================================
-- VARIABLES
-- ==================================================
Card1 = nil
Card3 = nil
-- ==================================================
-- ON LOAD
-- ==================================================
function onLoad()
    self.createButton({
        label = "DUPLICATE",
        click_function = "buttonPressed",
        function_owner = self,
        position = { 0, 0.3, -2 },
        rotation = { 0, 0, 0 },
        width = 1800,
        height = 600,
        font_size = 300
    })
end
-- =========================
-- BUTTON
-- =========================
function buttonPressed(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    detectThreeCards(player_color)
    if not Card1 then
        printToAll("No card to stamp detected. Please place a card at the left position.")
        return
    end
    if not Card3 then
        printToAll("No card to stamp detected. Please place a card at the left position.")
        return
    end
    -- do the grab
    spawnInfo = getCardData(Card1)
    fieldsInfo = getGrizzledTraits(Card3)
    -- do the clone
    spawnCardFromData(spawnInfo, Card3.getName(), fieldsInfo, { position = PosDestination, image = "George" })
end

-- =========================
-- DETECTION
-- =========================

function detectThreeCards(player_color)
    -- ping positions for debug
    Player[player_color].pingTable(self.positionToWorld(Pos1))
    Player[player_color].pingTable(self.positionToWorld(Pos2))
    Player[player_color].pingTable(self.positionToWorld(Pos3))
    -- detect objects
    Card1 = detectCard(Pos1)
    Card2 = detectCard(Pos2)
    Card3 = detectCard(Pos3)
    
    if Card1 then
        printToAll("Card to stamp detected: " .. Card1.getName())
    else
        printToAll("No card found at left position.")
    end
    if Card2 then
        printToAll("Upgrade Sheet detected: " .. Card2.getName())
    else
        printToAll("No card found at central position.")
    end
    if Card3 then
        print("Investigator Card detected: " .. Card3.getName())
    else
        printToAll("No card found at right position.")
    end
end

function detectCard(position)
    local hits = Physics.cast({
        origin = self.positionToWorld(position) + Vector(0, 1, 0),
        direction = { 0, -1, 0 },
        type = 1,         -- RAY
        max_distance = 5, -- how far down to search
        debug = false
    })
    for _, hit in ipairs(hits) do
        local obj = hit.hit_object
        if obj.getName() == "Card duplicator" then
            return nil
        elseif obj.tag == "Card" then
            return obj
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- =========================
-- GET CARDS DATA
-- =========================
-- This card gets a lot of info, to be able to spawn a card
---@param card tts__Object: a card
---@return table: a table that can be passed to spawnObject
function getCardData(card)

    if not card then
        error("No card provided", 2)
    end

    if not card.getName or not card.getDescription or not card.getGUID then
        error("Invalid card object", 2)
    end

    if card.tag ~= "Card" then
        error("Object is not a card", 2)
    end

    local data = {}
    data.name = card.getName()
    data.description = card.getDescription()
    data.guid = card.getGUID()
    data.position = card.getPosition()
    data.rotation = card.getRotation()
    data.scale = card.getScale()
    data.gmNotes = card.getGMNotes()
    data.tags = card.getTags()
    data.custom = card.getCustomObject()
    data.luaScript = card.getLuaScript()
    local success, state = pcall(function()
        return card.getLuaScriptState()
    end)
    data.luaScriptState = success and state or ""
    return data
end

-- This takes the Upgrade Sheet of Grizzled, and grabs the traits
function getGrizzledTraits(card)
    -- 1. Verificamos que el objeto exista y tenga datos
    if not card or card.script_state == "" then
        return {}
    end
    -- 2. Parseamos el JSON del script_state
    local data = JSON.decode(card.script_state)
    local allTraits = {}
    if data and data.selections then
        for _, entry in ipairs(data.selections) do
            if entry.text and entry.text ~= "" then
                -- 3. Dividimos los textos por la coma y limpiamos espacios
                for trait in string.gmatch(entry.text, "([^,]+)") do
                    -- Eliminamos espacios al principio y final de cada palabra
                    trait = trait:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
                    table.insert(allTraits, trait)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return allTraits
end
